name: Iori
message: 「...Hmm, she’s not here.」
I had headed to the training facility booked under Momiji’s name, only to find it completely deserted.

name: Iori
message: 「So what Setsugekka said was true.」
Setsugekka had told me, 『I keep sneaking into the places Momiji reserves, but there’s never anyone there.”
In other words, Momiji is making dummy bookings for facilities to create the illusion that she’s actually there.
Essentially, she’s just wasting facility time, something that would earn a normal student a massive reprimand.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji is quite the problem child herself, isn’t she...」
She acted as if the bad reputation of the Takamura Class was spreading due to other students and causing her trouble, but she’s hardly one to talk.
As I left the training facility and looked around, my eyes met those of a student.

name: Iori
message: 「Finally found you, Momiji.」
Momiji was standing there, as if keeping watch over the facility she’d reserved. Was she plotting something?

name: Momiji
message: 「And who might this be—oh, it’s Mr. Muragaki... Did you have some business with me？」

name: Iori
message: 「You’re a student in the Takamura Class, aren’t you? I’d appreciate it if you could attend class.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That subject again? I believe we’ve already reached a conclusion on that.」
The Suzakuin are self-sufficient, and as special students, they are exempt from class. I understood her stance perfectly well.

name: Iori
message: 「But I can’t accept that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Listen, Momiji. There is still something you lack. I want to help you with that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Something I... lack？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, exactly. So Momiji, let’s work hard together！」
What？ She suddenly looked away.

name: Momiji
message: 「That is a very interesting topic, but before we proceed, there is one thing.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Um, could you please stop calling me by my given name without an honorific？」

name: Iori
message: 「Why’s that？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m just... not very used to that sort of thing.」
Not used to being called by her given name... right, of course. It’s because she’s a Suzakuin.
The Suzakuin Family is an object of admiration for those in martial circles. Being the daughter of such a house, everyone treats her like she’s made of glass.

name: Momiji
message: 「And for the record, I don’t recall being close enough to you for that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is it really that annoying to be called by your name?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-I mean... having a man call me by my given name with no honorifics makes us sound like lovers, doesn't it...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wouldn't you hate it too, Sensei, if a young girl you aren't even close to like me just called you 'Iori'？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm？ Not really, I wouldn't mind.」
Ririmu already calls me "Iorin" and all.

name: Iori
message: 「Though during class, I'd like you to call me Sensei so it sets a proper example for everyone else.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wh— A-Are you an idiot?!」

name: Momiji
message: 「That means you're telling me to call you Sensei normally so nobody finds out about our relationship, and 'Iori' in private, right？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's literally what lovers do!」

name: Momiji
message: 「A forbidden romance between a student and a teacher is obviously out of the question！」
...Momiji sure has an active imagination.

name: Iori
message: 「Calm down, Momiji. Nobody's talking about being lovers.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Excuse me. I lost my composure.」

name: Momiji
message: 「A-Anyway, dropping honorifics is not allowed. It disrupts public morals.」

name: Iori
message: 「Public morals...」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you insist on calling me without honorifics, then do it after you beat me in a Jindou match.」

name: Momiji
message: 「However, laying a Suzakuin daughter low in a match is also tantamount to laying hands on her.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-In that case, you would have to enter a relationship with me with marriage in mind...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you prepared for that, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm, in that case, I'll just call you Momiji-san.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？！ Hold on！ Aren't you giving up way too fast？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「And what's with that 'in that case'?！ Do you really hate the idea of marrying me that much?！」

name: Iori
message: 「In the first place, you and I are teacher and student, Momiji-san. Starting a relationship with marriage in mind would completely defeat the purpose.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mgh... Well, I suppose that's true, but...」

name: Iori
message: 「So if you hate it that much, Momiji, I'm fine calling you Momiji-san.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Still doesn't sit right with me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It can't be helped. I'll make an exception and allow you—and only you, Sensei—to address me without honorifics.」

name: Momiji
message: 「However, I'll be calling you Iori-sensei in return！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You don't mind, of course？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's fine.」

name: Momiji
message: 「How can you agree to that so casually...！」
Momiji grumbles under her breath, muttering complaints to herself.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh right, one thing I wanted to bring up about the facility reservations.」

name: Iori
message: 「Booking a place you aren't even going to use isn't very admirable. It causes trouble for the other students, you know.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You can only say that because you didn't see the disaster back in April, Sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Right after I enrolled, a crowd would gather around the facility just from me booking it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Between people asking to watch and demanding matches with me, my entire reserved time would be over just dealing with them.」

name: Iori
message: 「So you kept making dummy reservations in self-defense.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Precisely.」
I see, so Momiji had her own reasons for doing it.

name: Momiji
message: 「My dummy reservation strategy paid off, and things finally started calming down once May rolled around.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And just when I thought I could finally have a practice match with Victoria-san, Kazamine-san barged in the other day.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm truly fed up with it all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「The Suzakuin name stands out, and my every move draws attention. I've already resigned myself to the fact that it can't be helped.」

name: Momiji
message: 「However, I have no intention of becoming some <d0037>sideshow attraction</d>.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I simply want to practice and train in peace—that's all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you're willing to clear the way for me, Iori-sensei, then I won't make any more dummy bookings for the facilities.」

name: Iori
message: 「Got it. I'll set up a quiet environment where you can practice in peace, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Really? Well, that puts my mind at ease.」

name: Iori
message: 「All right, now that we've got that settled, shall we head back to the classroom together?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don't want to.」

name: Iori
message: 「You said that pretty clearly, didn't you！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because Setsugekka is in the classroom, isn't she? It's obvious that would lead to trouble.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, you don't need to worry about that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka is currently in the middle of being taught all sorts of things by her mentor of the heart.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Who is that, or rather, what even is that, a ‘mentor of the heart’...?」
Well, I don't really know either.

name: Iori
message: 「So, Momiji, let’s head back to the classroom！」
What’s with that look of dissatisfaction... do you hate it that much？

name: Victoria
message: 「How are you！ Suzakuin-chan！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, Victoria-san.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...H-hello.」
Victoria-san walked up, with Shizuku-san appearing to hide behind her.

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry about the other day, both of you. Setsugekka got in the way.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Nnn, it’s fine~. But why are you the one apologizing？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, this person is a teacher for the Takamura Class.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ah, that Takamura Class full of nothing but troublemakers~！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Hey, Vicky, watch your language.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't worry about it, Shizuku-san. It's the truth, after all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m troubled as well, since there are so many students who are just plain hopeless.」

name: Iori
message: 「Why are you acting like this has nothing to do with you？ You’re quite the troublemaker yourself, you know.」

name: Victoria
message: 「AHAHA, Suzakuin-chan got scolded by her teacher~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don't accept that！ How am I a problem child！？」

name: Iori
message: 「By running away and skipping class.」

name: Momiji
message: 「As I’ve explained to you countless times already…！」

name: Victoria
message: 「You really need to make sure you attend your classes, Suzakuin-chan~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I do exactly what I’m supposed to do！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, she’s an honor student, so she’s exempt from classes.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm? What’s an honor student again?」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Goodness, I already explained that to you before, didn’t I…？」
Shizuku-san lets out an exasperated sigh.

name: Iori
message: 「Shizuku-san, you sound a bit like Victoria-san’s older sister, don’t you think?」

name: Victoria
message: 「She totally is！ Shizu takes care of all sorts of things for me~」

name: Victoria
message: 「She’s super attentive, and always helping me out.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「W-well, that’s just because you’re so unreliable, Vicky, so I have no choice but to…」

name: Victoria
message: 「She’s also super knowledgeable about Origami, and it’s Shizu who adjusts mine, too.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Shizu is my important partner~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you Victoria-san’s dedicated Second, Minamoto-senpai？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I wouldn’t exactly say dedicated… It’s just that I started helping her with the setups, and one thing led to another…」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hehe, whenever I mess with my Origami, I end up breaking it right away. Why does it always break, I wonder~？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「That’s because you force everything with brute strength.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Origami are precision instruments. Please, I’m begging you to handle them more gently.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay, okay, I get it！」
…She definitely doesn’t get it.

name: Iori
message: 「Come to think of it, I heard you’re in the Technical Division, Shizuku-san. But isn't the Minamoto family a prestigious martial house? Why the Technical Division?」
I ask her about the question I had last time.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ever since I was little, I’ve been more interested in the structure of Origami than in wielding them…」

name: Shizuku
message: 「As I was researching things like spirit-powered machinery, Tenju, gods, and <d0079>Keyou</d>, I found myself becoming quite knowledgeable about Origami, and so… things just went that way…」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Besides, I’m rather shy… and I don’t really like being in front of people or standing out…」

name: Momiji
message: 「I understand how you feel.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s tiresome when you don't want to stand out, but people put you on a pedestal anyway or view you through colored glasses, isn't it.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Y-yes, exactly... Even if people have strange expectations just because I'm of the Minamoto bloodline, I don't really care about lineage at all, or rather...」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. So both you and Shizuku have borne the same troubles from being born into famous clans.」

name: Victoria
message: 「That’s great, Shizu! Looks like you’re making new friends!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Eh? Calling someone a friend... wouldn't that be rude to Suzakuin-san...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Please don't say things like that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It feels a bit presumptuous to call my senior a friend, but if Minamoto-senpai is willing, then by all means.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Th-thank you so much...」
Shizuku hesitantly extends her hand to shake the hand Momiji is offering.

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, yes. How beautiful it is to see friends getting along.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes, that’s right！」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, Victoria-san, Shizuku-san, if you’re interested, come visit the Takamura Class sometime.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay, sure！ Is there anyone stronger than Momiji there？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm, I wonder.」

name: Momiji
message: 「There isn’t.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ah... speaking of strength, I looked it up a little after we met last time, but... Muragaki-sensei, you’re a graduate of this academy, aren't you...？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that’s right.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「You won the Martial Festival in your second year in the Martial Arts Division. Your record from that time is still in the database... that final match was an incredible battle...！」
...I see, so she saw that.

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, Iori-sensei, you were a Toujinegi？」

name: Iori
message: 「I was. But that's a story from a long time ago.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「However, what I’m curious about is when you were in your third year of the Martial Arts Division.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Despite having the top score in the preliminaries, Muragaki-sensei, you didn't participate in the main tournament. Was there a reason for that...？」

name: Iori
message: 「...I wasn't feeling well, so I withdrew. It was quite pathetic of me.」
Summer of our third year at the academy.
I had requested to withdraw from the main tournament, telling my homeroom teacher that I wasn't feeling well. So, what I just told Shizuku wasn't a lie.
But—

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm, so that means Muragaki-san is actually pretty strong, huh！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Muragaki-san, let's have a fight sometime！ A battle between the former and current Toujinegi！ I'm sure that would be a blast！」

name: Iori
message: 「I've only just been put in charge as the vice-homeroom teacher for the Takamura Class, so I'm busy. Let's do that once the class settles down.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm, so you mean once Suzakuin-chan starts behaving？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's exactly right.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Suzakuin-cha~n, make sure you listen to your teacher！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, you heard her！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why are you treating me like I'm a troublemaker...！？」
Momiji turns her face away with a huff.

name: Victoria
message: 「If you keep acting up, I'm gonna give Suzakuin-chan's muscles a good squeeze~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eek！？」
Victoria-san approaches Momiji while waving her hands around.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, I told you to stop it...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ooo-ouch！ That hurts, Shizu, stop pulling my ears！」
What are they doing?

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ah... Vicky, it's almost time for the practice match.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay！ Well, see ya later, Muragaki-san and Suzakuin-chan！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I'll give you a shout if I see you around.」
I watch the two of them run off toward the arena.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then...？」
I look around, but there's no sign of Momiji.

name: Iori
message: 「Wait... you've got to be kidding me！」
In the brief moment I looked away, Momiji had vanished.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey! Momiji! Where did you go!」
My class really is full of people who are good at running away...！
